assets.title: One sample, two readings
assets.description: An identical cobalt sample sits in warm and cool surrounds, then travels through source, profile, display or export, and viewer.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold one sampled colour constant; vary its surround, then map the digital chain to the viewer.

assets.title: A working lens for judging effects
assets.description: A disclosure-by-claim-change matrix separates disclosed stylisation, declared alteration, context-dependent judgment, and deception risk.
assets.visual_grammar: Map how much an edit shifts the image's claim against whether the shift is disclosed; leave the threshold open to context.

assets.title: Colour treatment and garment claim
assets.description: A fictional jacket appears as neutral source, expressive colour treatment, and a polished version with a garment detail removed.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold the fictional garment and framing constant; distinguish mood styling from an edit that changes the represented garment.

assets.title: Keep the source; make each edit inspectable
assets.description: A five-step workflow preserves the source, isolates an editable mask, applies effects on a separate layer, compares the result, and exports with a one-line disclosure.
assets.visual_grammar: Preserve the before; isolate the target; keep effect editable; compare intent and claim; disclose what changed.

assets.title: A textile colour moves from sample to screen
assets.description: A fictional design-studio still places a cobalt textile sample beside its screen rendering, a neutral card, and a colour reference strip to prompt questions about viewing conditions.
assets.visual_grammar: Set a physical sample beside a screen and reference materials; invite comparison across display and ambient viewing conditions without claiming calibration accuracy.

assets.title: A masked treatment that keeps the garment intact
assets.description: Three aligned fictional fashion-still frames show the source, an editable mask, and a background treatment while retaining the garment's structure.
assets.visual_grammar: Align one fictional source, an editable mask, and a restrained selective treatment; keep garment shape and detail stable so process logic stays visible.

assets.title: A flat reading becomes a testable volume
assets.description: One schematic garment panel is tracked from flat read through side elevation to a simple volume with shared axis and proportion cues.
assets.visual_grammar: Keep one form and its axis in view while its representation changes; make the depth proposal visible.

assets.title: Three views constrain one coherent volume
assets.description: Front, side, and top orthographic views connect to one axonometric volume while a contradictory contour remains visibly marked.
assets.visual_grammar: Projection guides constrain the form; a mismatch remains inspectable rather than being polished away.

assets.title: A convincing render still needs a process trail
assets.description: A smooth final volume is contrasted with a 2D read, a blockout with a marked ambiguity, and a revision that records its test.
assets.visual_grammar: Separate polished appearance from the visible evidence trail that explains a spatial decision.

assets.title: The axis holds a volume readable
assets.description: A simplified garment shell wraps a vertical axis; cross-axis and measured offsets make direction and proportion inspectable.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold a single volume stable while axis and measured offsets reveal proportion before surface polish.

assets.title: A section makes interior form inspectable
assets.description: A translucent cut plane reveals an interior contour in a faceted form.
assets.visual_grammar: Cut one volume with a visible plane; let the resulting section expose hidden form.

assets.title: Output and explanation answer different questions
assets.description: A polished surface is compared with a construction view of the same schematic volume.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold the object constant; change the view to show whether construction can be explained.

assets.title: Material Memory
assets.description: A material fold and a digital mesh diverge at one visible contour; the difference is preserved for comparison.
assets.visual_grammar: A material fold and a digital mesh diverge at one visible contour; the difference is preserved for comparison.

assets.title: Support And Drape
assets.description: A material span between two supports shows a stable contour and a deeper fall under load.
assets.visual_grammar: A material span between two supports shows a stable contour and a deeper fall under load.

assets.title: Evidence Pair
assets.description: A source fragment, a digital interpretation, and a local correction remain visible in one process record.
